text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The day after Drone-Go posted a photo of Fubuki writhing in agony after eating the "Moonlight Mudflower Ice Cream"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
マッドフラワーのアイスを食べて悶絶するフブキの写真が
ドロン号によって投稿された翌日──

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Vampy-chan looked way happier eating it, so how did she lose to Fubuki's "childish" photo~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～～ん？
ヴァンピィちゃんのほうがおいしそーに食べてたのに、
どーしてフブキの『おこちゃま』な写真に負けちゃったかな～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey...? Good little Vampy-chaaan♡? If you keep copying my flow and tease others like you just did, you'll turn into a "naughty girl", you know~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ～～？
いい子のヴァンピィちゃ～ん？♡
ぼくのマネして人を煽ってると、
ワルイ子になっちゃうよ～～～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I can't blame you for being jealous after I went a little viral, lol. You can't beat me anyway, so why don't you let those feathers droop and go, "I surrender, woof~♡"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま。
プチバズったぼくに嫉妬しちゃうのはしゃーねーかもだけど？ｗ
どーせ勝てないんだし、
その頭の羽を垂らして、
「降参だわ～ん♡」って
鳴いてもいいよ～？♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: I won't do any of that! I mean there's still time left! Bloodkin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうさんなんてしませんし！
だって、
まだぜんぜん時間あるもん！
けんぞくっ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki Vampy
text_block_list.text: "Treasure hunting"?
text_block_list.orig_text: 『宝探し』？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Are you watching? I went for a walk with Fubuki today♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなー！
　見てるー？
今日はフブキと一緒に、
お散歩したんだ♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: And then! We parted ways and went on a treasure hunt, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それからね！
とちゅーでお別れして
宝探しもしたんだけど──

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Vampy-chan found something amazing♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヴァンピィちゃん、
『すっごい』の
見つけちゃいました♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh, lol? I think my "insane" find is way more exciting, don't you♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～？ｗ
ぼくの『ヤバイ』やつのほーが、
みんなテンションあがると思うケドー？♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So, anyway♡ Today's video's a "Show-and-Tell of This Island's Hidden Treasures"♡ ...Hey, you losers, lol. I know you're just gonna skip to the ending first anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってなワケで。
今日の動画は
『この島の掘り出し物、
お披露目会』でーす♡
……
そこのザコｗ　
飛ばしてオチから先にみんなよｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hey. Your insane "find"... is it that chest? ...It looks kind of burnt and falling apart, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ。
フブキの『ヤバイ』って、
その宝箱？
……なんか、
焦げててボロボロだね？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Curious♡? I found this on the beach♡ I'm also excited to find out what's inside, nya~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
気になる？♡　
これ、
浜辺で拾ったの♡
なにが入ってるのか、
ぼくも楽しみだにゃ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Just kidding♡ Of course I've already checked the contents, lol~ I'm a thief, after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なーんて♡
中身はトーゼンチェック済みだけど～ｗ
ぼく、
泥棒だよー？ｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: It was my first time seeing a treasure chest sealed with alchemy, and inside were suuuper dirty books that practically corrupted my innocent eyes. But if it'll help me go viral, it'd be a waste not to use them♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術で閉じてる宝箱とかハジメテだったし、
中身はめっっっちゃハレンチな本で目がヨゴレちゃったケド。
バズのためには、
利用しない手はないよねー♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Here's the script: first, Onii-san opens the chest on my command, lol. Then he panics after seeing what's inside, lol. Right then, I'll peek in and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
台本はこう。
まずはぼくのメーレーでお兄さんが宝箱をあけるｗ
中身を確認したお兄さんが慌てるｗ
すかさずぼくがのぞき込んで──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: "Woooow~ Onii-san's reading naughty books, lol! You've got a gorgeous girl like me right here, but instead you're reading those? You're such a hopeless little perv, you loser~♡"... That's how I'll really spice things up♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
「わぁ～お兄さん、
ハレンチな本見てる～ｗ
ぼくみたいな美少女と一緒なのに
手ぇ出せずにそんな本読んじゃうとか
ホントエロエロでザコザコ～♡」ってカンジで盛り上げてやろ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi♡ My fans are all masochistic little losers anyway♡ They'll spread it everywhere once it's uploaded, lol. Let's see if Vampy can top this level of "insane"♡ So then~
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっ♡　
ぼくのファン、
ドMのザコばっかだし♡
動画が投稿されたら拡散してくれそーｗ
ヴァンピィにこの『ヤバイ』、
超えられるかな～♡　
ってコトで──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Vampy-chan, you've found something "amazing", haven't you? You must be itching to show it off♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヴァンピィちゃんもぉ、
『すごい』やつ見つけたんでしょ～？
早く見せたくて、
ウズウズしてんじゃない♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Not really...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　別にそんなことないけど……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: You don't have to be shy~♡ You can go ahead and present it first♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
エンリョしなくていいってばぁ～♡
先に見せていーよ♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hmm? I don't really get it, but Vampy-chan will start then♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん？
よくわかんないけど、
じゃあヴァンピィちゃんからいくね♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah♪
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃーん♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's what you think is "amazing"? It's just a flat slate, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？
　『すごい』のって、
それ？
ただの板じゃんｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Fubuki, don't you know? These are called magic slates♪ You seal monsters you've defeated inside them and use them for duels! Vampy-chan caught a new one here~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
フブキ知らないの～？
　これは、
魔札っていうんだよ♪
倒した魔物をここに封じ込めて、
決闘できるの！
ヴァンピィちゃんここで、
新しい子をゲットしたんだ～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I know all about magic slates, of course lol. So you're just happy you got some funny monster, right? Such a kid, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔札ぐらい知ってるっつーのｗ
お遊び用の魔物ゲットして喜んでるってことでしょ？
おこちゃまじゃんｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: I'm not a kid! I ran into the manager earlier and she was surprised when I showed it to her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おこちゃまじゃないし！
さっき運営のひとに会ってね、
見せたらびっくりしてたもん！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: This is super rare, so I want you to keep it forever!" she said! And later on, "Bloodkin will be surprised when you show it to him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「これは超レア級だから、
いつまでもずっと永遠に持っててほしい」
って！
あとあと、
「けんぞくに見せたらびっくりする」って言ってたし！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I'm not really into magic slates or anything of the sort y'know~ lol? So? What kind of loser (lol) got sealed there? What's the magic slate's name (lol)?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼく、
魔札とかきょーみないんで～？ｗ
で？
　どんなザコがそこに封印されちゃったワケ？ｗ
魔札のお名前は？ｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: It's "Sharkskin Fangmurai, the Sealed Sovereign of the Sea"♪ He's just been sealed away, so he can't be summoned yet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『封印されし海の主
「牙之丞」』だよ♪
ふーいんしたばっかだから、
まだ召喚できないけど！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Onii-san, aren't you getting a little TOO into it? Don't tell me you're some Magic Slate fanatic, lol? Such a guy thing~
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？
　なに？
　お兄さん、
食いつきよすぎない？
まさか
魔札マニアとか？ｗ
オトコノコってカンジ～

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: As expected of Vampy-chan's Bloodkin♪ You understand just how rare this magic slate is♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっすがヴァンピィちゃんのけんぞく♪
この魔札の良さがわかっちゃうんだね♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: You see, I was walking along the beach when this little one came running towards me from across the sea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね、
浜辺を歩いてたら、
この子が海の向こうから
ぶわ～って走ってきたの。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: There are a lot of people here, right? I thought it might be dangerous, so Vampy-chan defeated him and turned him into a comrade♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここ、
たくさんひとがいるでしょ？
危ないかなーって思ったから、
ヴァンピィちゃんがやっつけて、
仲間にしたんだ♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: What do you think? That's "amazing", right♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
どーお？
　『すごい』でしょ♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that, Fubuki~? Bloodkin praised Vampy-chan's efforts as "amazing"~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞いた、
フブキ～？
ヴァンピィちゃん、
けんぞくに『すごい』って褒められちゃった～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmmmmm. Is it really that "amazing"? ...Hmph.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ～～～～～～～～～～ん。
そんなに『すごい』んだ～？
……ふんっ。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.orig_text: あっ……！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hey, handle it carefully, okay? As I said before, I've just sealed that monster, so it's "sensitive".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと～、
ていねいに扱ってよね？
さっきも言ったけど、
ふーいんしたばっかで、
『せんさい』なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If it's sealed away, then it should be fine, right? By the way, did you just call this thing the "Sovereign of the Sea"? Lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
封印されてんならダイジョーブでしょ？
てかさ、
海の主って言ったっけ？ｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: He got caught by Vampy so easily, isn't he actually a weakling♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっさりヴァンピィちゃんにつかまっちゃうとか、
ホントはザコザコなんじゃないの？♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Got anything to say... Fangmurai-kun (lol)? *Poke, poke*♡ Ihihihi, lol. How does it feel now that I'm doing whatever I want to you? Lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにか言ったら～
牙之丞く～ん？ｗ
　
つーんつーん♡　
いひひひっｗ
ヒリキなぼくにいいよーにされて、
今どんな気持ち～？ｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Ah, Fubuki, any more than that and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
フブキ
それ以上は──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: OHHHHH, LOUISE MARIEEEE!!!! WHY CAN'T IT BE MEEEEEE!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおお、
ルイズマリィィィー！！
なぜ俺じゃ駄目なんだーーーっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEHHHHHH?! WHAT ARE YOU DOING OUT HERE?! AND WHO'S LOUISE MARIE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぇぇえ～！？
　なに勝手にショーカンされちゃってんのぉ！？
ルイズマリーって誰だしっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: You're that dull man... My rival in love! ...No, I don't care anymore. That love's already over... the deer girl is long gone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様は冴えない男……
俺の恋敵！
……いや、
もう気にはしまい。
あれはもう、
終わった恋だ……
鹿の角の君……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so you got dumped. Is that why you were running across the sea crying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん、
振られちゃったんだ。
だから泣きながら海の上を走ってたの？

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Don't just assume I was rejected! You little kid who doesn't even know the first thing about love, you're toying with my broken heart...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝手に振られたと決めつけるなっ！
恋のこの字も知らなそうなお子さまが、
傷心中の俺の心を弄びやがってぇ……！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Take this! HEARTBREAK PUUUUUUUUUNCH!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くらえぇいっ！
失恋パーンチ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *DUUUUM*!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: バコーンッ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAH?! YOU BROKE MY TREASURE CHEST! WHERE ARE YOU AIMING, YOU IDIOT!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃぁぁぁっ！？
　ぼくの宝箱が壊れた！
どこ狙ってるしバカァ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...W-What about its contents!? My treasure!? Where'd that naughty book go?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
中身は！？
ぼくのお宝は！？
　ハレンチな本、
どこいった！？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: It came flying through the air, so Vampy-chan caught it for you♪ This is it, right? Fubuki's "Naughty Book"♪ Here you go♪ Your "Naughty Book", Fubuki♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
飛んできたから
ヴァンピィちゃんがキャッチしておいたよ♪
これでしょ？
　フブキの『ハレンチナホン』って！
はい、
返すね♪　
フブキの『ハレンチナホン』！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: HEY~?! DID YOU JUST REPEAT THAT ON PURPOSE?! I mean, you just ruined my plan to frame Onii-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ～！？
　わざと言ってる！？
ってか
お兄さんをはめる計画、
ヴァンピィのせいで台無しじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmm. So you already knew what was inside the treasure chest, Fubuki?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ～～～ん。
フブキ、
宝箱の中身、
知ってたんだ～～～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: As if I care about that right now! That guy is so noisy and annoying, can't you do something about him?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなコトどーでもいーからぁ！
アイツさ、
うるさいしジャマだからどーにかしてくんない！？

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: You summon me, then treat me like this...? Especially you, the pink-haired girl with the venomous tongue... What is your name?
text_block_list.orig_text:
呼び出しておいてその態度とは……
特に
そっちの毒舌ピンクの君……
名はなんという？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huuuuuuh?! I DID NOT summon you, like AT ALL! I mean, you don't know Fubuki-chan, the third daughter of the great thieves guild, the "Bandy Sisters", the cutest girl in the universe? What kind of fossil are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁああ～～～！？
　呼んでねーから！
ってか
大盗賊ギルド
【バンディ・シスターズ】の三女、
宇宙一カワイイフブキちゃんを知らないとか、
どこの化石かってのｗ

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: ..."Fubuki, the Cutest Girl in the Universe"... thirty strokes, hmm. And "Sharkskin Fangmurai"... thirty-six...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……宇宙一カワイイフブキ……
三十画か。
で、
俺。
鮫肌牙之丞が三十六画だから……

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: WHA!! 98% COMPATIBILITY?! Once again...! Fate has blessed me this summer...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！！
　相性98％だと！？
この夏二度目の運命、
きた……！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What's that guy reading?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
アイツ、
なに読んでんの？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Let's see... "A Love Fortune Telling Book That's Always Accurate".
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと～
『よく当たる恋占い』
だって。

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: So with that said, let's go out. Fubuki-chan, the cutest girl in the universe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ということで、
交際しよう。
宇宙一カワイイフブキちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh, lol? You're just some lolicon shark, aren't you? Gross! Somebody arrest him already, then fillet him into three pieces♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ？ｗ　
ただのロリコンザメとかｗ
キモ！
　キモすぎの現行犯で
早く逮捕からの三枚おろしに処刑されちゃってくださーい♡

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Playing hard to get... I like that. Come, let us go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
つれない態度。
そこが好きだ。
さあ、
行くぞ。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey! Fangmurai! Let Fubuki go!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
　こら！
　牙之丞！
フブキを放しなさい！！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Now, Fubuki. Shall we have our wedding ceremony? There's a church with a beautiful ocean view. I'm sure you'll love it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
フブキ。
二人の結婚式を挙げようか。
素敵なオーシャンビューが広がる教会だ。
きっと君も気に入るぞ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: WHO WOULD EVERY MARRY A FREAKING SHARK THAT SMELLS LIKE SEAFOOD!? Seriously, you're a TOTAL loser! AND THAT CHURCH IS DEFINITELY INSIDE THE OCEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAN!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰が生臭い魚と結婚するかっての！
マジでザコザコの雑魚！
ってかその教会、
ぜっっったい海の中じ
ゃ～～ん！！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Fangmurai! Hey, wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
牙之丞！
　こらっ、
待ちなさ～い！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: O-Onii-san...! And while I'm at it, Vampy too...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お兄さん……！
ついでのついでぐらいに、
ヴァンピィも……！

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: I'll never fall in love again... AS IF I'D ABIDE THAT! NOTHING can stop me now that I've awakened to TRUE LOVE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう恋なんてしない……
なんて言うものか！
真実の愛に目覚めた俺を
止めることなどできはしない！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: ...Hah, hah. I can't keep up at all, and he's not listening to me at all. You know him, right, Bloodkin? Is there no way to stop him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はぁ、
はぁ。
ぜんぜん追いつかないし、
ぜんぜん話聞かないし。
けんぞく、
あいつのこと知ってるんでしょ？
止める方法はないの？

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Heh... YOUR slap worked. A slap from the woman you love hurts more than anything else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フッ……
あのビンタは効いた。
惚れた女のビンタは
なにより
痛い。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: A slap...? How'd that work?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビンタ……？
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. So Fangmurai's weak against a slap from the girl he likes? That means he's been slapped before? I guess that makes sense... He does seem like the persistent type.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふーん。
牙之丞は好きなひとからのビンタに弱いんだ？
ってことは、
前にもビンタされたことあるってこと？
そっか～
牙之丞、
しつこそーだもんねー

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Fubuki! Slap him! Give him a big slap on the cheek!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フブキ～！
　ビンタだって～！
牙之丞のほっぺに
ばちーんってやっちゃえ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean? I don't get it...! But... Onii-san would never lie to me. He may be a newb, but he's still my Big Bro...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにそれ、
意味わかんなすぎ……っ！
……
でも、
お兄さんはぼくにウソつかない、
ザコザコだけど、
ぼくのお兄さんだから……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I BELIEVE IN YOU! NEWB BIG BRO!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
信じてるからね！
　ザコお兄さんっ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: *Slap*♡
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ぺちん♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bloodkin. He looks fine to me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
けんぞく。
ぴんぴんしてますけど？

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Heh... I'm not the shark I once was. I've grown. Evolved. A slap is rejection... No. It is simply love in another form.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ……
俺はあの頃の俺ではない。
一回りも二回りも進化し、
辿り着いた。
ビンタ、
それは拒絶……
否。
それは愛の裏返し。

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: ...So I shall receive it. Fu-bu-ki♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……しかと受け取ったぞ。
フ・
ブ・
キ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH! ONII-SAN YOU LIAAAAAAAAAR!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわあぁぁん！！
お兄さんのうそつき～～！！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Fubuki~! Final attempt! You have the magic slate, right? It seems we have no choice left but to have him re-enter it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フブキ～！
　さいしゅーしゅだん！
魔札持ってるでしょっ？
それでもう一回、
さいふーいんするしかないかもー！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If that was possible, I'd have tried from the start! I have to weaken it or create an opening... She HAS to know how hard it is to pull it off~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それができんなら最初っからやってるっつーの！
弱らせるか、
スキをつくるか。
封印すんのむずいって知ってるくせに～！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I don't have any other weapons. Weakening him's basically impossible... So... an opening? Wait... In my hands is... Ah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
他に武器もねーし。
弱らせるとかムリゲーだし。
じゃ、
スキ？
　
今のぼくの手札なんて……
あ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Can I really pull it off...? Not that I want to do this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
いけるか……？
マジやりたくないケド……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Kh... Hey, newb shark.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ちょっと、
ザコ鮫。

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: What is it, Fubuki?!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
フブキっ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! His mouth smells of fish...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
げろっ……！
口、
なまぐさっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I-I've got something really great right here...! Look♡ At this "book"♡ Gaze away♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼ、
ぼくさ～
すっごくいいもの持ってるんだぁ～
ほら♡　
この『本』♡　
見て♡

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! What's with that pink cover?! I-It cannot be~
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ……！？
　なんだそのピンクな表紙は！？
ま、
まさか──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Wow, lol! Your face is really red (lol), so much so that I think I'll call you "Puremurai" from now on, lol!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっわｗ　
めっちゃ顔真っ赤じゃんｗ
今日から『ピュア之丞』って呼んであげよっかｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Look, look, this page is amazing♡ The very beginning of the book... an incredible illustration in color♡ Look, look, look~? lol
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら、
このページとかすごいよ♡
本の一番最初……
カラー付きのヤバイ挿し絵♡
ほらほらほら～～～？ｗ

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Fubuki! Aren't you going too far?! ...Ugh! My eyes... it's poison to my eyes...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待てフブキ！
　貴様進みすぎでは！？
……ぐっ！
　目……っ、
目の毒……！！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*... It looks like Fangmurai has finally stopped... I don't really know what's going on, but... Fubuki, one more push...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
やっと牙之丞が止まったみたい……
何してるかよくわかんないけど……
フブキ、
あともう一押し……！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: See all this? Look how packed the pages are with text♡ This book's full of a girl's desires... I mean♡ Romance♡ Lots and lots of romance♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
見える～？
　ぎ～～っしり詰まったこの文字。
この本には女の子の欲望……
じゃなくってぇ♡
ロマンスがた～～っぷり詰まってんの♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Read this and learn how to treat girls♡ Then maybe girls will start thinking about you too♡ As a friend, anyway♡ Hey, don't look away♡ Here we go~
text_block_list.orig_text:
女の子の扱い方、
これ読んでお勉強しなよ♡
そしたら女の子だって考えてくれるよ♡　
オトモダチとして♡
って、
目ぇ背けてちゃダ～メ♡　
ほらほら、
いくよ──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: NEEEEEEEEEWB~!!!! lol

text_block_list.name: ナレーション
text_block_list.text: ─ビタンッ♡
text_block_list.orig_text: ─ビタンッ♡

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: A-A girl's... sk... skin...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じょ、
女子の、
は……
……はだ……

text_block_list.name: Sharkskin Fangmurai
text_block_list.text: BWAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぶはーーーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: LOL! Getting a nosebleed just from being slapped in the face with an illustration is so pathetic, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はｗ
　顔面に挿し絵ビンタされたぐらいで
鼻血出すとか
ザコすぎなんですけどｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Wait... HOLD IT, WAIT! DON'T JUST COLLAPSE WITH ME IN YOUR HAND...!!?!? AAAHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──って、
待って待って！
そのまんま倒れるのはなしだからぁぁぁぁっ……！！！？？？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Kyuuu...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぅきゅ～～……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Phew, we finally caught up... Ah, Fangmurai's weakened! Fubuki, now's your chance! This is no time to be sleeping!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ～、
やっと追いついた～……
あ、
牙之丞が弱ってる！
フブキ、
今がチャンスだよ！
　寝てる場合じゃないよ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: K-Kh... I'm not sleeping because I want to...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
好きで、
寝てるワケじゃないっつーのぉ……！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Mmm... MAGIC SLATE: CAPTUREEEEEE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
魔札封
印～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...So, I took another look at the video that the Drone-Go took. It's just accident footage, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
でさ。
改めてドロン号が撮った動画を見直したけどさ。
やっぱこれ、
ただの事故映像じゃん。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh? That's not true! The part where you sealed him in the magic slate was awesome! It's definitely going to be the best video you made! Probably even better than Vampy-chan's!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっ、
そんなことないって！
魔札にふーいんするところ、
熱かったじゃん！
絶対
今までで一番伸びるよ！
　たぶんヴァンピィちゃんよりも！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Alright, sure. Thanks for the comforting words. Ah, Drone-Go, please edit it nicely and post it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい。
なぐさめあざ～
あ、
ドロン号、
いい感じに編集して投稿よろ～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it's seriously going viral so fast!? I'm getting more Loves than ever before!? Why...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
マジで伸びてるんですけど！？
過去イチでラヴもらえてる！？
なんで……！？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Heheh♪ See? I told you so♪ It'll grow even more than Vampy-chan♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふん♪　
ほらね、
言ったとおりでしょ♪
ヴァンピィちゃんよりも伸びるって♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Despite losing in terms of Loves, Vampy was in high spirits. Fubuki, on the other hand, was feeling a mix of happiness and bewilderment at having gone viral once again in an unintended way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラヴの数では負けているのに、
ヴァンピィは上機嫌だった。
そしてフブキは、
またもや不本意な形でバズったことに、
うれしさと困惑の気持ちが混じり合っていたのだった。
